observation as the bleeding had stopped, Attempted ligation of 
mass and feeding vessel during this hospitalization or as an 
outpatient, termination of pregnancy. She was seen by social 
work, who felt she may benefit from a psychiatric evaluation. 
Psychiatry was consulted and saw the patient on hospital day 4. 
She was felt to be appropriately dealing with the difficult 
nature of the diagnosis, with no acute concerns for her safety. 
Continued outpatient therapy was recommended.

hemodynamically stable, and she was discharged home with

incision.) But if they fall off before that that's okay.

normal.

Avoid direct sun exposure to the incision area.

Constipation is a common side effect of narcotic pain

surgeon has said its okay.

pain medicine.

or when you are doing your deep breathing exercises.

Take all the medicines you were on before the operation just as 
you did before, unless you have been told differently.
